title: A hyperbolic group without a geometric CAT(0) action

result.label: A hyperbolic group without a geometric CAT(0) action
result.statement: Answers negatively whether every word-hyperbolic group is a CAT(0) group. Constructs one with a finite classifying space but no proper cocompact isometric action on any proper complete CAT (0) space, in any dimension.
